text.p: Following are the main stories in Croatian newspapers on Friday.
- The National Security and Defence Council (VONS) suggests ways of fighting criminal acts in economy, particularly in the privatisation process.
- Preliminary identifications of 30 Ovcara mass grave victims carried out so far in Zagreb.
- The first Italian bank, Cassa di Risparnio di Trieste - Banca d.d. to open its branch in Zagreb today.
- Zagrabacka banka launches the process of getting its credit rating.
- Out of the $600 million worth of former Yugoslavia assets, Croatia is to get 2,280 shares and a relevant share of hard currency and gold bars.
- Those responsible for the crimes at the Ovcara mass grave were in a big hurry, says in an interview U.S. forensic pathologist William Haglund. -- Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
